article.body:
FlatClip proposes a geometry-aware fMRI representation-learning baseline

An arXiv paper titled “FlatClip: A Geometry-Aware Surface-Level Baseline for fMRI Representation Learning” was posted in the cs.CV category on 28 September 2026; the available record does not identify its authors. The paper proposes FlatClip as a surface-level, geometry-aware baseline for fMRI representation learning. The supplied record provides no details of the architecture, datasets, experiments, model count, or quantitative results. Its evidence and comparative performance therefore cannot be assessed from the available material.
